full_judgment: 8. Mr. Md. Mozammel Hossain, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners in the course of his argument after placing the evidence of both the sides and other materials on record including the judgments of two Courts below submits that the impugned judgment of the Court of appeal below is not a proper judgment of reversal inasmuch as the Courts of appeal below without adverting the material findings of the trial Court below most illegally set aside the judgment of the trial Court holding that the Government is the actual owner of the suit land and as such the impugned judgment and decree dated 20.7.2005 is liable to be set aside. The learned Advocate next submits that most of the PWs. in their respective deposition did not state the story of dispossession of the plaintiff from the suit land and the trial Court below on due consideration of the entire materials on record rightly arrived at a finding that the plaintiff having miserably to prove his title as well as possession and dispossession of the suit land.
